name: Base vs Waves
desc:
🔥 Defend your base against endless waves of enemies! 🔥

✨Update (May 30): A new enemy unit has been added, and an auto-start feature for enemy waves has been added

Stop the advancing enemy soldiers and don’t let them break through to your base. Buy soldiers from the store, plan your strategy, and place them in key positions to stop the enemy!

💥 Use airstrikes to wipe out large groups of enemies at critical moments.
🧠 Combine different unit types and find the best defense tactics.
🌊 With each wave, the enemies get stronger - are you ready for the challenge?
⚔️ Upgrade your defenses, earn money, and prove that your strategy is the best!

Developers: @Hiirumah322 and @Kusko322
